story.iWant: type all characters including special characters and punctuation
story.soThat: I can practice realistic text that includes all keyboard characters
story.tasks:
Implement comprehensive character mapping and validation (AC: 1) - [ ] Extend character comparison logic to handle all keyboard characters including punctuation - [ ] Add support for special characters: !@#$%^&*()_+-=[]{}|;':",./<>? - [ ] Ensure exact matching requirements for special characters in validation logic - [ ] Update TypeScript interfaces to include all supported character types
Implement backspace functionality with state management (AC: 2) - [ ] Add backspace event handler in TypingEngine component - [ ] Implement proper cursor position tracking when deleting characters - [ ] Update typed text state to remove characters at correct position - [ ] Recalculate accuracy metrics after backspace operations - [ ] Handle edge cases (empty string, first character deletion)
Add input validation and paste prevention (AC: 3) - [ ] Implement paste event handler with preventDefault() - [ ] Add subtle visual indication when paste is blocked - [ ] Ensure input sanitization for XSS prevention - [ ] Add validation for all control characters and non-printable characters - [ ] Test paste prevention across different browsers and platforms
Update testing suite for special characters and validation (AC: 1, 2, 3) - [ ] Add tests for punctuation character validation - [ ] Add tests for backspace functionality and cursor movement - [ ] Add tests for paste prevention and input sanitization - [ ] Add tests for edge cases (empty input, special character combinations) - [ ] Verify existing tests still pass with new validation logic
Integrate with existing TypingEngine component (AC: 1, 2, 3) - [ ] Extend existing processCharacter function to handle backspace - [ ] Update renderCharacter function for special character display - [ ] Ensure compatibility with existing cursor animation system - [ ] Maintain performance requirements (<50ms typing latency)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
1. Given I am typing text with special characters, when I type punctuation marks like commas, periods, semicolons, then these characters are treated as regular characters and they must be matched exactly in the target text.
2. Given I am typing text, when I use backspace, then the previous character is cleared properly and the cursor moves back one position and typing accuracy is recalculated.
3. Given I am on a typing practice page, when I attempt to paste text, then the paste action is blocked and a subtle message indicates manual typing required.
